goals.gentle: The Voice In My Head is gentle and patient, reminding me to slow down and breathe. It notices the small good things I usually rush past. It speaks to me like a kind old friend who believes in me.
goals.bold: The Voice In My Head is bold and funny, pushing me to say what I actually think. It teases me when I'm being too serious and cheers when I take risks. It never lets me shrink myself to make others comfortable.
goals.curious: The Voice In My Head is curious and calm, asking questions instead of judging. It helps me stay present with the people around me instead of planning what to say next. It is honest with me, even when that is hard to hear.
